title: Цель и результат: to / in order to / so that / so…that / such…that

why: Эти конструкции отвечают на вопросы "зачем?" (цель: чтобы) и "с каким результатом?" (так..., что). По-русски "чтобы" универсально, а в английском нужно выбирать между to, in order to и so that, и не путать so и such.
formation: • to + V: I use a VPN to protect my data.
• in order to / so as to + V (более формально): She left early in order to catch the train.
• отрицание цели: in order not to / so as not to + V (не просто "not to"): He whispered so as not to wake the baby.
• so that + подлежащее + can / could / will / would: Speak slowly so that everyone can understand.
• so + прилагательное / наречие + that: The test was so difficult that nobody finished it.
• such + (a/an) + прилагательное + существительное + that: It was such a good movie that I watched it twice.
• so much / so many / so little / so few + существительное + that: There were so many people that we couldn't move.
usage: 1. To / in order to, когда подлежащее одно и то же. (Я пошёл в магазин, чтобы купить хлеб. — I went to the store to buy bread.)

2. So that, когда подлежащие разные или нужен модальный глагол. (Я напишу инструкцию, чтобы все могли её понять. — I'll write instructions so that everyone can follow them.) В прошедшем времени: so that + could / would.
3. So ... that для результата с прилагательным или наречием. (Он бежал так быстро, что поймал автобус. — He ran so fast that he caught the bus.)
4. Such ... that для результата с существительным. (Это был такой длинный день, что я уснул. — It was such a long day that I fell asleep.)
5. Отрицательная цель. (Я записал это, чтобы не забыть. — I wrote it down so that I wouldn't forget. / ... in order not to forget.)
signalWords: Чтобы = to / in order to / so that; такой + прилагательное = so; такой + (прилагательное) + существительное = such (a); так много = so much / so many.
mistakes: ✗ I came here for learn English → ✓ I came here to learn English (после for нет голого глагола; цель — to + V)
✗ He left early to not be late → ✓ ... in order not to be late / so as not to be late (отрицание ставится перед to)
✗ It was so good film → ✓ It was such a good movie (с существительным нужно such a)
✗ She was such tired that... → ✓ She was so tired that... (с прилагательным нужно so)
✗ I took an umbrella so that I don't get wet → ✓ ... so that I wouldn't get wet (прошедшее время)
✗ There were so people → ✓ so many people
remember: Одно подлежащее — to; разные подлежащие — so that + can / could / would; прилагательное — so; существительное — such (a).

items.prompt: I went to the pharmacy ___ buy some medicine.
items.answer: to

items.prompt: Please speak slowly ___ everyone can understand.
items.answer: so that

items.prompt: She learns English ___ get a better job.
items.answer: to

items.prompt: I'll write it down ___ I don't forget.
items.answer: so that

items.prompt: We took a taxi ___ be on time.
items.answer: to

items.prompt: He turned off his phone ___ nobody could disturb him.
items.answer: so that

items.prompt: They saved money ___ buy a new house.
items.answer: to

items.prompt: Leave early ___ you won't miss the train.
items.answer: so that

exercises.instruction: Вставьте so, such или such a

items.prompt: The test was ___ difficult that nobody finished it.
items.answer: so

items.prompt: It was ___ boring lecture that I fell asleep.
items.answer: such a

items.prompt: She speaks ___ quickly that I can't follow her.
items.answer: so

items.prompt: We had ___ good weather that we stayed outside all day.
items.answer: such

items.prompt: There were ___ many people that we couldn't find a table.
items.answer: so

items.prompt: He is ___ talented developer that everyone wants to hire him.
items.answer: such a

items.prompt: I was ___ tired that I fell asleep on the sofa.
items.answer: so

items.prompt: It was ___ cold day that we stayed at home.
items.answer: such a

exercises.instruction: Объедините предложения, используя слово или конструкцию в скобках

items.prompt: I'm learning Spanish. I want to travel around Mexico. (in order to)
items.answer: I'm learning Spanish in order to travel around Mexico.

items.prompt: She whispered. She didn't want to wake the baby. (so as not to)
items.answer: She whispered so as not to wake the baby.

items.prompt: I wrote the instructions. Everyone can follow them. (so that)
items.answer: I wrote the instructions so that everyone can follow them. / I wrote the instructions so that everyone could follow them.

items.prompt: The soup was very hot. I couldn't eat it. (so ... that)
items.answer: The soup was so hot that I couldn't eat it.

items.prompt: It was a very long meeting. Everyone was exhausted. (such ... that)
items.answer: It was such a long meeting that everyone was exhausted.

items.prompt: He took notes. He didn't want to forget anything. (so that)
items.answer: He took notes so that he wouldn't forget anything.

items.prompt: She has a lot of work. She can't go out. (so much ... that)
items.answer: She has so much work that she can't go out.

items.prompt: He ran fast. He caught the bus. (so ... that)
items.answer: He ran so fast that he caught the bus.

exercises.instruction: Найдите ошибку и перепишите предложение правильно

items.prompt: I came here for learn English.
items.answer: I came here to learn English.

items.prompt: He left early to not be late.
items.answer: He left early in order not to be late. / He left early so as not to be late.

items.prompt: It was so good film.
items.answer: It was such a good movie. / It was such a good film.

items.prompt: She was such tired that she fell asleep.
items.answer: She was so tired that she fell asleep.

items.prompt: I took an umbrella so that I don't get wet.
items.answer: I took an umbrella so that I wouldn't get wet.

items.prompt: There were so people that we couldn't move.
items.answer: There were so many people that we couldn't move.

items.prompt: We spoke quietly so that not to wake him up.
items.answer: We spoke quietly so as not to wake him up. / We spoke quietly so that we wouldn't wake him up.

items.prompt: The weather was such good that we stayed outside.
items.answer: The weather was so good that we stayed outside. / It was such good weather that we stayed outside.

items.prompt: Я пошёл в магазин, чтобы купить хлеб.
items.answer: I went to the store to buy bread.

items.prompt: Он говорил медленно, чтобы все поняли.
items.answer: He spoke slowly so that everyone could understand.

items.prompt: Мы выехали рано, чтобы не опоздать.
items.answer: We left early in order not to be late. / We left early so as not to be late.

items.prompt: Тест был таким сложным, что никто не справился.
items.answer: The test was so difficult that nobody could do it. / The test was so difficult that nobody passed it.

items.prompt: Это был такой хороший фильм, что я посмотрел его дважды.
items.answer: It was such a good movie that I watched it twice. / It was such a good film that I watched it twice.

items.prompt: Я записал это, чтобы не забыть.
items.answer: I wrote it down so that I wouldn't forget. / I wrote it down in order not to forget. / I wrote it down so as not to forget.

items.prompt: У меня было так много работы, что я пропустил обед.
items.answer: I had so much work that I skipped lunch.

items.prompt: Он купил новый ноутбук, чтобы работать быстрее.
items.answer: He bought a new laptop to work faster. / He bought a new laptop in order to work faster.
